category.stopped: Each category.*: a failure category on the Reliability page of the Operations dashboard (a badge, a list row, a menu choice). Short. Stopped isn't a failure: a person or an operator stopped the turn.
category.not_available: A failure because something isn't connected or set up (no model, an expired sign-in…).
category.model_provider: A failure of the company or server that runs the AI model.
category.unclassified: Failures the rules couldn't sort; an admin or the model may label them later.
hint.stopped: Each hint.*: one line under a failure category (and its tooltip) saying what falls in it. "Turn": one answer from a socio (an AI agent); "round": one call to the model within a turn.
span.minutes: A short span of time, in a tile: {{n}} minutes. Abbreviated.
span.hours: A span of time, in a tile: {{n}} hours. Abbreviated.
span.days: A span of time, in a tile: {{count}} days, with one decimal (2.5 days).
versus-before: A tile's note: how a number moved against the same length of time just before the range. {{change}} is the movement (+12%, −3%, Same, New, or +1.2 pts).
tiles.failure-rate: Tile and chart title: the share of turns (answers from a socio) that failed.
tiles.of-turns: The failure rate tile's note when there's nothing to compare against. {{failures}} and {{turns}} are already-formatted counts (or – with no data); {{count}} picks the plural.
tiles.points: A change in percentage points. {{change}} is the signed number (+5.0, −1.2, ±0.0).
tiles.interrupted-note: Note under the Interrupted tile: the server stopped while a turn was running.
tiles.stopped-note: Note under the Stopped tile: stopped turns aren't counted as failures.
tiles.of-calls: Note under the Failed tool calls tile: out of how many tool calls in all.
tiles.retries: Tile: retries of a model call, and fallbacks (moving a turn to another model after the first failed).
tiles.retries-note: {{count}} turns had a retry; {{fallbacks}} (a formatted number) moved to the workspace's shared model.
chart.category-share: Chart title when one category is picked: {{category}} is one of category.*.
chart.description: Under the failure chart: each bar or point is a time bucket (an hour, a day, a week or a month, by context).
chart.category: Accessible name of the menu that picks which failure category the chart shows.
chart.every: Menu choice: chart every failure, not one category.
chart.y: What the chart's values are, in a sentence for screen readers ("Bar chart of percent of turns by day"). Lowercase.
categories.turns: How many failed turns fell in a category.
categories.tool-calls: How many failed tool calls fell in a category.
categories.interrupted: How many turns the server interrupted (shown with Runtime error).
show: Button that narrows the Recent failures list to this row's category or tool and scrolls to it.
no-code: Shown in place of an error code when none was recorded.
breakdown.description: Under Where failures happen, grouped by socio, model or source. The _tool and _code forms are for those groupings.
breakdown.group-by: Accessible name of the menu that picks how Where failures happen groups (by tool, error code, socio, model, source).
breakdown.by.tool: Each breakdown.by.*: a choice in the Group by menu, and the list's accessible name. "Socios" are AI agents (product noun); "sources" are channels messages come through (web, Telegram…).
breakdown.not-recorded: Shown in place of a socio's, model's or source's name when it wasn't recorded.
breakdown.turns: How many failed turns ended with this error code.
breakdown.failed: {{failed}} failed out of {{total}}, and the share that failed.
breakdown.latency: How long a tool's calls (or the turns) took: {{p50}} is the median, {{p95}} the slow end (1 in 20 took longer); both formatted durations. Keep p50 and p95 as is.
friction.title: Card title: failures that keep happening to people.
friction.people: How many people hit the same failure.
friction.times: How many times it failed in all; {{most}} is the most times for a single person.
friction.last: When it last failed; {{when}} is a date and time.
failures.description: "Trace": a turn's record of what the model and tools did.
failures.clear: Accessible name of the × on a filter chip; {{name}} is a failure category or a tool's name.
failures.failed-tools: In a failed turn's row: how many of its tool calls failed.
failures.status.running: Each failures.status.*: a turn's status in its row.
label.by: In a failure's row: the model (an AI) set its category label. The _admin form: an admin did.
